Container.Name: shoko-sonarr-linker
Container.Overview: Automatically links verified Sonarr anime episodes to unrecognized Shoko files. Enter Sonarr and Shoko connection details; the service starts read-only and enables linking only after safe setup is complete.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite state and mapping cache; keep on local or cache-backed storage.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Sonarr base URL reachable from this container; use a host/IP if Docker DNS is not shared.

Config.Name: Sonarr API Key
Config.Description: Sonarr API key. Stored only in the container environment.

Config.Name: Shoko URL
Config.Description: Shoko base URL reachable from this container; use a host/IP if Docker DNS is not shared.

Config.Name: Shoko API Key
Config.Description: Shoko API key. Stored only in the container environment.

Config.Name: Dashboard Port (optional)
Config.Description: Optional host port mapping for the private dashboard. Leave empty to publish no dashboard port; if enabled, keep it on a trusted local network.

Config.Name: Advanced YAML Config (optional)
Config.Description: Optional read-only config directory for advanced CLI use. Normal service startup does not require a YAML file.
